Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : a) Five (05) years of general experience.
b) Experience of Supply & Installation of lightning protection work, individually or along with Electro mechanical works (where the
component of lightning protection works suffice the minimum requirement) of 02 (two) contracts amounting minimum 10 (Ten) lac
each or single contract amounting minimum 20 (Twenty) lac within the last 05 (five) years of Government/Semi-
Government/Autonomous Bodies in Bangladesh.
i) In case of the work done under PWD, the certifying and authenticating authority shall be the concerned Executive Engineer.
ii) In case of the work done under any Government/ Semi-Government/ Autonomous Bodies/ Organization other than PWD, the
certifying authority shall be an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer.
c) Average Annual Construction Turnover shall be greater than Tk. 120 (One hundred twenty) lac over the last five (05) years.
d) The minimum amount of Liquid Assets or Working Capital or letter of Commitment for Bank’s Undertaking for line of Credit as
per Form PW2a-3 of Tender and Contract Forms must be submitted for this Purpose of the Successful Tenderer shall not be less
than Tk. 20.00 Lac Only The Supporting Bank Document submitted along with the Tender must be issued in between Publication
date & Submission date of the Tender.
e) The minimum tender capacity of Tk 23.00 lac.
f) Up to date ABC/BC category Contractory & Electrical Supervisory License from Bangladesh Electrical Licensing Board. Heir or
Authorization ABC/BC License will not be entitlement.
g) UP to date Income Tax clearance Certificate from the NBR with TIN. Upto 2017-2018 (Tex Year).
h) Up to date VAT Registration Certificate from the NBR.
i) UP to date Trade License.
